name: Roast Football (RFB)
technique: Predictable on-chain randomness; Brute-force lottery payout
rootCause: RFB (Roast Football) on BNB Chain was exploited on December 5, 2022, after its on-chain lottery was brute-forced. Attackers predicted lottery outcomes using only publicly available inputs, repeatedly winning large payouts from the contract's reward pool. At least 12.17 WBNB (≈$3.6K at the time) was drained in one flash-loan-enabled attack, with no cooldown or anti-bot protection. The protocol used a fully on-chain, attacker-steerable pseudorandom number generator for its lottery payout, allowing the attacker to adjust buy sizes until the lottery seed hit a deterministic jackpot condition. This led to predictable, repeatable payouts with no restriction.
